newsitem.title: USA: Candela Corp says Japan clears systems.
newsitem.headline: Candela Corp says Japan clears systems.

text.p: Candela Corp said Thursday that the Japanese government has cleared two powerful new laser systems that gently treat skin conditions native to the Asian population, brown pigmented skin lesions such as Nevus of Ota, Mongolian spot and traumatic pigmentation.
The devices, both using Candela's Alexandrite Laser technology, are known as the AlexLAZR and the PLTL Pigmented Lesion/TATULAZR, the company said.
The laser systems have received marketing approval from Japan's Ministry of Health and obtained reimbursement approval from the National Health Insurance of Japan, Candela said.
